d:
In this video, I travel from Bandar Abbas to Chahbahar in Balochistan, on an incredible 700KM road journey. From the challenges of entering Balochistan to travelling through remote landscapes, struggling to find petrol, experiencing the local life and spending almost 2 days on the road, I capture every moment of this unforgettable journey until finally reaching Chabahar.
An adventurous journey through one of the least explored regions, showing its roads, people, culture and the unexpected experiences along the way.
